lines.ko: 해 질 무렵 그 강가에 서면
lines.id: Saat senja, aku berdiri di tepi sungai itu
lines.en: When I stand by that river at dusk
lines.sung: 해 질 무렵 그 강가에 서면

lines.id: Lampu menyala di kampung kita di seberang
lines.en: Lights come on in our village across the water
My hair has turned white before I knew it

lines.id: Dalam ingatanku, kau masih sembilan belas
lines.en: In my memory, you are still nineteen
At the slightest river wind through the reeds
I hear the voice that used to call my name
Min, are you still there?

lines.id: Di bawah asap tungku makan malam
lines.en: Beneath the smoke of supper fires
Those words of yours: Brother, go first
Still hold me where I stood

lines.id: Tanpamu, rumah tak lagi terasa rumah
lines.en: Without you, home never felt like home
Little brother, can you hear my voice?

lines.id: Pagi itu, hujan musim panas tercurah
lines.en: That morning when the monsoon rain poured down

lines.ko: 네 몫의 밥을 내 손에 쥐여 주고
lines.id: Kau letakkan jatah nasimu di tanganku
lines.en: You pressed your own share of rice into my hand
lines.sung: 네 몫의 밥을 내 손에 쥐여 주고

lines.ko: 내 손을 놓으며 웃던 그 얼굴
lines.en: That face that smiled as you let go of my hand
lines.sung: 내 손을 놓으며 웃던 그 얼굴

lines.id: Setelah aku berpaling, mungkinkah kau menangis?
lines.en: After I turned away, did you perhaps begin to cry?
It was your older brother's promise to protect you

lines.id: Mengapa justru kau yang harus menjagaku?
lines.en: Why did you have to be the one to protect me?
Min, are you still there?

lines.id: Di bawah asap tungku makan malam
lines.en: Beneath the smoke of supper fires
Those words of yours: Brother, go first
Still hold me where I stood

lines.id: Tanpamu, rumah tak lagi terasa rumah
lines.en: Without you, home never felt like home
Little brother, can you hear my voice?

lines.id: Mungkinkah kau juga melihat lembayung ini?
lines.en: Could you be watching this same sunset?

lines.id: Saat senja, apakah kau memanggil namaku?
lines.en: When evening comes, do you call my name?
Because you told me to stay alive and go home

lines.ko: 난 오늘도 살아 여기 서 있다
lines.id: Hari ini aku masih hidup, berdiri di sini
lines.en: I am alive and standing here again today
lines.sung: 난 오늘도 살아 여기 서 있다

lines.en: Min, are you still there?
Your brother is waiting for you here
I am sorry I am so late, my little brother

lines.id: Kali ini, biar kakak yang tinggal
lines.en: This time your brother will stay behind
It gets cold after sunset, my little brother
Let us go home; let us go together

lines.ko: 대답 없는 강 위로 해는 저물고
lines.id: Matahari tenggelam di atas sungai yang tak menjawab
lines.en: The sun goes down over the river that gives no answer
lines.sung: 대답 없는 강 위로 해는 저물고

lines.en: Min, your brother is here
